controls.title: Evidence records are structurally linked
controls.scope: LOG.md, WHY.md, PARKED.md, CHANGELOG.md, and README.md in this repository
controls.expected: All record IDs are unique, required fields exist, and every cross-reference resolves.
controls.evidence: pytest output and the release conformance JSON report
controls.blind_spots: Does not determine whether narrative content is substantively true.

controls.title: Known prohibited claim forms remain absent
controls.scope: Current product README, SECURITY, Enterprise Python, Ultra JavaScript, and current assurance profiles
controls.assertion: Run the bounded claim-language regression test.
controls.expected: No known banned phrase or prospective-partner documentation directory is present.
controls.evidence: pytest output and the release conformance JSON report
controls.blind_spots: Natural-language claim detection is partial and does not understand every possible paraphrase.

controls.title: Unknown classifications fail closed
controls.scope: Classification labels, policy/profile construction, and LedgerObserver ingress
controls.assertion: Run label, policy, classified-mode, observer, and red-team suites.
controls.expected: All named suites pass, including malformed-classification denial tests.
controls.evidence: pytest output and the release conformance JSON report
controls.blind_spots: Does not intercept markings parsed by code outside these modules.

controls.title: Governed MCP actuation composes mandatory gates
controls.scope: GovernedRuntime and Enterprise MCP dispatcher actuation paths
controls.assertion: Run governed-runtime and MCP dispatcher tests.
controls.expected: Policy trust root, live target, approval context, control plane, persistent ledger, transport enqueue, and new UIA readback gates pass or fail closed.
controls.evidence: pytest output and the release conformance JSON report
controls.blind_spots: Direct SDK calls and other repositories are not globally intercepted; deterministic tests do not establish a live Windows target.

controls.title: Terminal target identity uses protected image paths
controls.scope: Current target_guard mappings for Windows Terminal and classic Windows console classes
controls.assertion: Run the target-guard load and class-spoof test.
controls.expected: Live HWND enumeration completes deterministically, user-writable lookalike image paths are refused, and protected Windows/package paths are accepted.
controls.evidence: Target-guard load-test output and the release conformance JSON report
controls.blind_spots: Does not validate Authenticode signers or protect a compromised trusted binary, administrator, or kernel; unmapped terminal classes fail closed.

controls.title: Live governed terminal delivery and execution effect
controls.scope: One inspected live Windows terminal HWND, one signed policy/identity, one bounded command, and its signed action ledger
controls.assertion: Run tools.irs_runtime_conformance with --execute and an --expect-output token that is absent from --text, then independently read the target.
controls.expected: Target binding and policy pass; UIA confirms a new payload occurrence; the separate output token newly appears; the signed ledger verifies.
controls.evidence: Conformance JSON, independent UIA readback, screenshot hash if retained, exact target metadata, and ledger verification result
controls.blind_spots: A result applies only to the tested terminal version, shell, policy, identity, action, session, and machine. It is not external-workflow, WORM, government-authorization, or scale evidence.

controls.title: Ultra lifecycle proofs reject tamper and replay
controls.scope: Ultra agent-auth verifier and production-store unit/integration tests available in the current environment
controls.assertion: Run the Ultra Node test suite.
controls.expected: Authentication tests pass; PostgreSQL tests pass when DATABASE_URL is supplied and otherwise report an explicit skip.
controls.evidence: Node test output and the release conformance JSON report
controls.blind_spots: A skipped PostgreSQL suite is not production durability evidence.

controls.title: Live Python-to-Node lifecycle contract
controls.scope: A running Ultra Server at the configured endpoint using current Python and Node code
controls.assertion: Start the intended sidecar and run both live contract suites with unavailable-server skipping disabled.
controls.expected: Node live checks and Python tests pass with real HTTP and cryptographic operations.
controls.evidence: Live command output and retained conformance report
controls.blind_spots: Development-mode success does not establish production persistence or restart durability.

controls.title: Production identity and HOTP state survive restart
controls.scope: Production Ultra composition with PostgreSQL, Redis, operator secret, recovery secret, and a killed/restarted Node process
controls.assertion: Run tools.ultra_restart_conformance seed, stop the exact server process, restart it, then run verify against the same state file.
controls.expected: Agent ID, BPC pair, TSK client, HOTP-bearing map, and a post-restart verification remain valid.
controls.evidence: Seed/verify JSON output, service logs, dependency versions, and deployment commit
controls.blind_spots: Cannot be reduced to one safe generic command because process ownership and secret injection are deployment-specific.

controls.title: Off-host immutable evidence deployment
controls.scope: Selected provider bucket, retention/legal-hold configuration, credentials, custody, and restore procedure
controls.assertion: Perform provider API retention readback, write/seal/readback, denied overwrite/delete tests, and an isolated restore drill.
controls.expected: Every provider and recovery check passes against the actual deployment boundary.
controls.evidence: Provider API responses without secrets, object/version IDs, receipt hashes, and restore report
controls.blind_spots: Repository tests cannot authorize or inspect an undeployed provider account.

controls.title: Government authorization status
controls.scope: The selected cloud service offering, Mission Owner system, data classification, personnel, and authorization boundary
controls.assertion: Review the authoritative PA/ATO/IATT and RMF package for the exact deployment.
controls.expected: The responsible external authority documents the applicable authorization and conditions.
controls.evidence: Externally issued authorization artifacts and assessor records
controls.blind_spots: No software test can create an ATO, Impact Level authorization, clearance, or classified operating approval.
